entry_points.text: Rights first: restriction flag blocks all, else read-all and size stay open; proc skips rechecks except open; restricted acts need privilege; hook decides last. Console off/on/level save, restore, clamp, reenable. Reads fit starts, emit with time marks, resync losses, wait dropping mutex; clear jumps past newest; open/close are no-ops; sizes report; unknown fail. Bounds gate sizes; fitting skips arrivals; bad buffers fail.

Options map empties to null TTY, strip braille, split device/TTY styles, fix shorthand, index from trailing digits, store user entries. Early boot sets null-TTY default, inits discipline, runs traced initcalls. Late boot drops init-memory consoles, adds CPU hooks, inits sysctls; print table registers; CPU notice flushes unless frozen.

Update holds CPU read lock and static mutex, skips unchanged targets, publishes function with trampoline patch, walks core and module sites patching matches, skips post-boot init sites, warns once off kernel text, honors tails. Unready state skips patching past trampoline; storageless keys ignored.

exports.text: Devkmsg, variadic and deferred print route to central output; flush fans out per active mode. Shared and timed limiters gate output. Optional tag sets facility/level with user fallback; disable mask forces no-op success; bounds cap records. Reads hold opener mutex across check/wait/advance. Crash setup prints ring layout; zero call is default static target.

Init builds empty descriptor and text rings with seeded edges, zeroed arrays, and linked storage. Text-space query reports reserved capacity. Next-sequence starts past last finalized, or zero at bootstrap, scanning forward while valid.

Table adds consoles by name/index or device name with options, marks user entries, and binds device names to drivers later. Matches reuse entries absent braille options; empty or negative-index entries rejected; full table reports too big. Entries carry names, index, options, user flag.

TTY lookup returns first driver/index found. Suspend flushes then disables; resume enables, wakes offload by kind, then flushes. Promotion moves a console to head; replay rewinds all and flushes. List changes hold list lock with SRCU grace. Consoles carry identity, flags, sequence, linkage, callbacks, data.

Registration needs a callback, rejects duplicates, appends; unregister rejects unknown entries and waits RCU grace, updates under dump spinlock. Reasons map to names. Retrieval clamps and repairs cursors, fits oldest records with terminator reserve, formats in order, then walks older blocks. Clients carry callback, flag, linkage.

invariants.text: Suspend support defaults enabled with early disable; retention, format, loglevel-ignore, delay with loop calibration, and non-panic-CPU output are early-boot set. Delays over ten seconds clear; format needs exact keyword; each option reports handled.

Normal and NMI byte counters track recursion, NMI context selecting NMI storage. Pending bits exchange atomically in lazy work that flushes or wakes legacy path and waiters. Deferral holds under forced mode, nesting, NMI, or sync ownership. Release drops nesting first, vacancy only at zero.

Index masks equal capacity minus one. Static build presets last descriptor reusable with failed linkage, initial heads/tails, zero failures, so first reservation reaches zero. Iteration steps while valid. CPU growth needs multiprocessor above half base. Pending length keeps increases, clamps to max, rounds to power of two.

Sysctls expose levels, ratelimit interval/burst, delay bounded zero to ten thousand, devkmsg control, admin-gated dmesg and pointer limits; privileged writes need admin rights. Static keys mask flag bits; tail, init, type bits pick site or module lists. Ordering sorts by owning key address; force-reinit warns unless initialized.

Safe depth counts enter/exit pairs, deferred forms pinning migration; forced-console counter nests. Wake predicate skips atomic/offload and unusable consoles, waking on valid pending records. Shutdown clears running once, stops threads, flushes backlog; late step marks threads ready.

locks.text: Console ownership order is tracked by a dependency map, owner task pointer, and waiter flag.

Print CPU owner is atomic CPU id or negative-one free, plus nesting count; waiters spin, acquire uses compare-exchange winning when free or same-CPU reentrant. Static updates hold a dedicated mutex. External mutex, alloc, copy, wait, cpumask, kthread, atomic helpers are owned elsewhere.

state_machines.text: Open allocates context with default rate state, release flag, mutex, cursor at oldest valid; global disable mask denies all opens. Non-write-only needs read-all rights, write-only skips. Release exits rate state, destroys mutex, frees. Seek needs zero offset with end/set/data origins; poll signals readable when cursor record valid, error on loss.

Setup migrates static to dynamic storage unless switched; late calls mark CPU readiness; size extends from CPU share absent explicit value; bad counts or failed allocs diagnose and clean up. Early records bulk-copy, then arrivals under interrupt lock with drop counts; sizes report with early-free share. Finalize copies text with timing, identity, device data, reporting used space or zero.

Legacy thread waits, then flushes one record per locked pass, learning next sequence, handover, retry; retry repeats at once. Descriptors move reserved to committed to finalized to reusable, with negative miss on id mismatch.

structs.text: Opener state pairs cursor, throttle, mutex, buffers; shared global buffers back context-less use. Metadata holds sequence, time, length, facility, flag/level, caller, device data. Descriptors join atomic state with text positions; rings join pointers with atomic head/tail; transfer objects pair metadata with buffers; data blocks are id plus payload; handles link reserve to commit.

Count is power of two; initial block position negated size; initial descriptor reusable. Size helper is two to bit count; state word keeps top-two flag bits with shift, flag mask, id mask. Failed and empty-line sentinels plus combined failed initializer. Recursion limit three; caller mask top bit; pending flags one and two; delay bound ten thousand.
